passage.label: Al-Baqarah — Messengers preferred over others; Isa given clear proofs and supported by Ruh al-Qudus; if Allah willed those after him would not have fought; no compulsion in religion; right path distinct from wrong; whoever rejects taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the trustworthy handhold; Allah is Hearing Knowing; Allah is wali of believers bringing them from darkness to light; disbelievers' allies are taghut bringing them from light to darkness; companions of Fire eternally

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞تِلۡكَ ٱلرُّسُلُ فَضَّلۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۘ مِّنۡهُم مَّن كَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُۖ وَرَفَعَ بَعۡضَهُمۡ دَرَجَٰتٖۚ وَءَاتَيۡنَا عِيسَى ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَيَّدۡنَٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلۡقُدُسِۗ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقۡتَتَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُ وَلَٰكِنِ ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ ءَامَنَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن كَفَرَۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقۡتَتَلُواْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا بَيۡعٞ فِيهِ وَلَا خُلَّةٞ وَلَا شَفَٰعَةٞۗ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٞ وَلَا نَوۡمٞۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

لَآ إِكۡرَاهَ فِي ٱلدِّينِۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشۡدُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيِّۚ فَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَاۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

ٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُخۡرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَوۡلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتُ يُخۡرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِۗ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

mainSubject.label: Messenger hierarchy and divine preference; Isa ibn Maryam given bayyinat and confirmed by Ruh al-Qudus; divine will as sole determinant of human conflict or peace; no compulsion in religion as foundational principle; guidance clearly distinguished from misguidance; rejection of taghut combined with belief in Allah constitutes grasping the unbreakable handhold; Allah as Hearing and Knowing; divine wilayah over believers manifesting as extraction from darkness into light; taghut's counter-wilayah drawing disbelievers from light into darkness; eternal consequence of disbelief

subordinateSubjects.label: Messenger preference: some raised in degrees above others
Allah spoke directly to some messengers
Isa ibn Maryam: bayyinat + Ruh al-Qudus confirmation
Divine will prevents or permits post-prophetic fighting
Spend before Day with no trade, friendship, or intercession
Ayat al-Kursi: Allah la ilaha illa huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum
No drowsiness or sleep overtakes Allah
Kursi encompasses heavens and earth; preservation does not tire Him
No compulsion in religion (la ikraha fi al-din)
Rejecting taghut + believing in Allah = grasping urwah wuthqa
Allah as wali of believers: darkness to light
Taghut as awliya of disbelievers: light to darkness

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: spend from what We have provided before a Day comes with no trade, friendship, or intercession.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Religious freedom as divine ordinance: no compulsion
Human epistemic limitation: cannot encompass Allah's knowledge except what He wills

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Eschatological urgency: spend before Day of no exchange or intercession

notes: Pass A pilot 12, passage 37/6. Contains Ayat al-Kursi (2:255), the most renowned single verse in the Quran. Establishes no-compulsion principle (2:256), messenger hierarchy, and divine wilayah theology. Links to tawheed-rububiyyah, tawheed-fundamentals, asma-ul-husna.
